hook: A 1928 condominium building whose 24 apartments are held as 24 separate parcels, four to a floor.

narrative.lead:
2201 Sacramento Street is a condominium building of 1928 whose 24 apartments are held as 24 separate parcels — lots 017 through 040 on block 0638 — numbered 101 through 604, four to a floor across six floors.
This page's parcel is lot 017, unit 101, so the assessed value and last sale shown below are that unit's and not the building's.
